file_impact.reason: Add RebarRawDescriptionHelpFormatter(RebarHelpFormatter): version-pinning + fixed width + raw _fill_text, for verify.py raw-description factories.
Switch 12 stock argparse.HelpFormatter families to RebarHelpFormatter and verify.py 3 RawDescriptionHelpFormatter factories to RebarRawDescriptionHelpFormatter (25 call sites).
Regenerate wrapping help artifacts (bridge-fsck.txt and any wrapping verify-*.txt) from width-78 to canonical width-80; non-wrapping artifacts unchanged.
New contract test failing if any registered parser factory renders through a formatter not subclassing RebarHelpFormatter.
Docs CLI-reference regenerated in case an affected help body is embedded.
Complexity ratchet baseline if new symbols (formatter subclass / contract test helpers) are introduced.
